What Phase of the RFP Process Are We In?





1 Community Visioning

Thank you to everyone who shared their vision for the future of Parcel E! Check out the Hunter’s Point South Parcel E Community Visioning Report to read about what we heard and the key findings. Navigate to the How to Get Involved tab for more information about how HPD has engaged the community. 

2 Open Request

The Hunter’s Point South Parcel E RFP was released on June 13, 2025.Submissions were due on September 5, 2025.


To access the RFP documents, please navigate to the Submit an RFP Response tab

3 Submissions Review

HPD reviewed submissions and designated the winning development team on July 29, 2026.

To learn more about the RFP process, please navigate to the RFP Process and FAQs tab.


4 Developer Designation

On July 29, 2026, HPD announced the designation of Parcel E to a development team consisting of Slate Property Group, The Hudson Companies, and Volunteers of America. The development team will transform the site into mixed-use, mixed-income development with affordable housing, a daycare center, a workforce development center, an indoor community pool, and commercial retail space.

The project is expected to produce approximately 950 new homes, including 658 income-restricted to low- and moderate-income households.

For more information about the selected development proposal, check out the press release.

To learn more about the RFP process, please navigate to the RFP Process and FAQs tab.

Sign Up to Receive Updates

Please sign up below to stay informed about the project.

Members of the public may also email HuntersPointE@hpd.nyc.gov with questions and inquiries.
